```json
{
  "winner": "B",
  "reasons": [
    "B's demand evidence is stronger and sourced. It gives three independent, linked complaints across multiple years and venues (two Reddit threads plus the HN seed thread), all describing the same price pain. A offers only one linked LinkedIn comment and an uncited 'seed HN quote'.",
    "B's existing payers are proven at the exact price point being targeted. At least four sourced competitors (Lessrec, TranscribeBee, TranscribeVoice, Speechnotes) already charge individuals per minute or per hour with no subscription. A's sourced price anchors (SwagUp $99/mo, Sendoso $15k-$20k+/yr) describe team or enterprise buyers, not the solo-founder long tail A wants to target. The brief itself flags that segment's willingness to pay as an open question.",
    "B is much easier for one person with AI agents to build and fulfil within 90 days. It is a software-only Whisper wrapper with a free organic channel in the forums where the complaint appears. A's own case against says its hard parts (sourcing, warehousing, customs, breakage, address failures) are physical-logistics problems agents don't solve. A also carries PII and international-customs obligations.",
    "A's sourced competitor pricing (Sendoso $15k-$20k+/yr) points to enterprise, sales-led selling, which fits a lean solo operator poorly. B's main threat is commoditization, which hurts long-term margin more than it blocks a first paying customer.",
    "Several of B's strongest negatives are unsourced and are counted as missing: the free Google on-device app, Untold's free bundled transcription, and the 'free free' user sentiment. Only MacWhisper's one-time pricing is linked. Without them, B's case against rests mainly on crowding, which caps differentiation but also proves people will pay."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "A's only cited demand signal is a single LinkedIn comment from someone who received Stripe's gift and asked which vendor was used. That shows curiosity, not intent to buy, and the brief admits as much ('from someone receiving rather than needing to build it'). The 'seed HN quote' it builds on is never quoted or linked, so it counts as missing.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate-to-low confidence. Both briefs show crowded markets with incumbents already offering the core mechanic. B wins mainly on more sourced demand quotes and lower execution risk for a solo, agent-run build, not on clear evidence that a new entrant can differentiate. B's tiny per-user revenue and unanswered differentiation question mean a first paying customer is plausible, but a viable business is not demonstrated by either brief."
}
```
